dict.string: Screen Stuff shows your camera as a tile on the board when you add one. Nothing is recorded.
Screen Stuff listens for how loud you are, so the camera can grow while you talk. No audio is recorded, stored or sent.
Screen Stuff puts the displays and windows you choose on a board, and shares the part of it you point at.
Screen Stuff serves a guest link on your network, so people nearby can open the board in a browser.
